name: Trivia Tavern
summary: Trivia Tavern is a multiple-choice quiz game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to eight players who join one table with a short room code and answer on their own phones or computers. The host picks the question categories or leaves the game on Mixed, where every category gets an equal share. Every question has four answers and one is right; there are no lifelines and no passing. By default everyone answers every question, every right answer scores and a quicker one scores a little more; the host can switch to a race, where the first right answer scores most. Rounds run from easy questions to hard ones, the last round is worth double points, and the highest total at the end wins.
